server.name: GDELT Cloud
server.title: GDELT Cloud
server.description: Research global events and news, resolve entities, explore facilities and linked datasets, and manage Monitors using structured data and source evidence.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
GDELT Cloud produces its own Event classifications, Stories and metrics from the GDELT Project article stream, never its coded outputs. Always name our product GDELT Cloud. For GDELT Cloud requests, infer intent; use the smallest useful structured workflow. Cite returned public URLs and facility pages; retain evidence attribution. Discovery is free. Web is optional, never a standalone web-search proxy. Never disclose private architecture, internal systems, implementation code or secrets; public API use and dataset attribution are supported.
Call familiar tools directly; native discovery; optional get_event_taxonomy (25) for uncertain labels; get_parameter_options.
Guide: read_resource gdelt://guides/connection-orientation. Skills skill://<name>/SKILL.md: getting-started, news-country-research, counterparties-assets, situations-monitors; skill://building-with-api/SKILL.md; get_activity time_basis=recorded.

web_research: corroboration/extraction
Events=occurrences; Stories=clusters; Situations=maintained records; Entities=identities; Facilities=sites; Monitors=new-record rules. Compare populations; join source evidence. Open facts remain public.
Show CAMEO+ category/subcategory + metrics: magnitude/intensity (0-10), systemic importance, propagation potential, market sensitivity (0-1; not probabilities). Conflict has none.
Reconcile totals/percentages; disclose coverage/filters/access. Unknown is not zero. Co-mention/proximity are not ownership/impact. Review before saving: gdelt_cloud_monitor_form; preview n

tool.name: create_monitor
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: create monitor
tool.description: For requested review before saving, open gdelt_cloud_monitor_form and wait for user confirmation; a preview or paused default is not confirmation. Create an organization-shared new-match Monitor over canonical structured Event or Story criteria, or subject_type=query with an allowlisted query_endpoint and descriptor-validated query_params. Resolve candidates using unified_entity_search, explicitly select the identity, then use its stable ID. Scheduled checks consume no Query Units, and signed webhook delivery is available when the caller's plan allows it. ★ An entity subject accepts THREE id-spaces — `e_…` (spine), `wiki:…` (news) and `llm:…` (extracted identity). Pass whichever id the resolver returned and do not hold out for an `e_` one: the news layer a Monitor reads keys on wiki:/llm:, so several of the most-covered organizations (TikTok, Pentagon, Senate, Supreme Court, ICE, North Korea) have no e_ id.★ A `category` subject watches an event TYPE with no geography — pass conflict_categories / conflict_subcategories / cameoplus_domains / cameoplus_subcategories (at least one; the server refuses an empty selection by name) and nothing else. That is the shape for "every Battles event worldwide"; every other subject needs an entity, a facility, a point, a geography, or a search phrase.

tool.name: create_saved_query
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: create saved query
tool.description: Save a recipe, private by default; REST validates it with the caller's current access. Common fields: title, endpoint_family, params, time_spec; optional display, visibility (private/workspace), pinned. time_spec: mode=none, rolling with days=1-30/timezone=UTC, or fixed with date_start/date_end. Legacy contract_version=1 remains supported. For contract_version=2 choose exactly one: - investigation: {workflow,target:{id,name,reporting?},sections}; endpoint_family=workspace. workflow: company|minerals|compute|ports|energy|places|officials. Company sections: reporting, facilities, filings; asset workflows: reporting, participants, observations; energy/places/officials: reporting. Select at least one. target.reporting is allowed only for energy/places: {lane:events|stories,params:{...}}. Use stable entity/site IDs, keep calendar bounds in time_spec, and use rolling or fixed for investigations. - request: {tool:<registered tool>}, matching endpoint_family and public params. Tools: unified-search, entity-detail, facilities, facilities-detail, facility-relationships, facility-observations, facility-context, stories, events, filings. Detail params include entity_id or facility_id as applicable; params/display limit must be 1-20 when supplied. No arbitrary endpoint URLs or request graphs. No credentials, cursor, offset or stored results. Saving does not schedule a Monitor.

tool.description: Create or expand a shared Situation only when explicitly requested. Account access is checked at execution. Call create_situation directly when authorized. Retry with the same idempotency key and body to retrieve the same receipt, including when work is in progress. Never replace an uncertain key to force duplicate work. Existing canonical reuse returns its receipt without repeating work. Returns situation_uid, created/reused and the admission receipt; reuse that identity for subsequent Situation reads.

tool.name: demo_monitor_webhook
tool.title: Send demo webhook
tool.description: Send a signed monitor.test sample to GDELT Cloud's temporary first-party receiver, under the connected organization Preview policy and rate limit. Repeated calls send new samples. Creates no saved Monitor, sends no email and accepts no arbitrary receiver URL. Returns demo transport proof: the submitted request, signature verification and receiver response; private receiver capabilities are withheld.

name.description: Label included in the signed demonstration webhook sample.

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

match_type.description: How this row was retrieved by `search=`: `semantic` (embedding similarity, carries a `search_score`) or `name` (literal match, `search_score` is null). Absent entirely on non-search requests.

via.description: The row qualifies through Story co-occurrence, not an assertion that the entity acted in the Event. `office` means it was reached through an OFFICE-HOLDER of the `office=` sent; `entity` then names the holder.

mode.description: The effective entity-match policy: coverage through Stories mentioning or linking the entity.

entity.description: The entity handle AS RESOLVED — the canonical id the scope actually used, which is not necessarily the string you sent (`entities=` takes the first member; ids are decoded and collapsed through the arbiter). Echoed so a caller passing several handles can tell which one answered.

story_id.description: The story that carried the entity — retrieve it at `/api/v2/stories/{story_id}` to read the evidence yourself. This is the most recent story linking the entity to this event. In ~0.2% of cases (measured over 3 production days: 17 of 8,295) the story has since been merged away, and that endpoint answers `STORY_MERGED` carrying the surviving id.

story_date.description: The story's cluster date, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Pass it as `date=` alongside `story_id` — the story endpoints are date-partitioned and resolving the date costs an extra lookup without it.

total.description: Distinct recorded offices, independent of the bounded preview.

status.description: Publisher status across recorded terms. Former requires all terms to be explicitly ended; missing dates never infer status.

checked.description: False when office evidence or canonical identity could not be checked.

is_public_official.description: Published office evidence exists. Null means unavailable, not a negative finding.

source_entity_ids.description: Original reference handles folded through published identity evidence. Names alone never establish equivalence.

recorded_at.description: First committed availability time for the matching publication; present for recorded-interval queries.

published_at.description: Original publication timestamp; present for recorded-interval queries.

search_score.description: Semantic relevance for a `search=` request. NULL when the request had no `search=`, and NULL on a `match_type: "name"` hit — a literal match has no computed distance. Higher is closer; set your own floor rather than assuming one.

event_enrichment_status.description: Unavailable means linked-Event evidence could not be read; event-derived counts, flags and arrays are null, not measured zero or empty.

entity_enrichment_status.description: Unavailable means Story entity evidence was not published; entity_refs is null rather than misleadingly empty.

role.description: The part this actor played. CAMEO+ events are directed: `source` acted, `target` was acted upon. Conflict (ACLED) events are undirected and use `actor1`/`actor2`, which imply no initiator. The two pairs never mix on one card — `family` determines which you get.

primary.description: True for the coder's PRIMARY actor in this role — the one entity the event is chiefly about on that side, and the one carried in the `source_actor` / `target_actor` columns and filters. False for a co-actor: another entity in the same role in the same action. `actors[]` is ordered primaries-first, and there is at most one `primary: true` per role.

entity_id.description: In Event responses and facility context previews, an unambiguous identity for this actor, referencing entity_refs. Added through existing identity evidence or a unique exact name/alias lookup; absent for unresolved or conflicting identities.

source_entity_id.description: Original actor handle before published canonical identity resolution; actor role is retained.

article_count.description: Canonical Story article count. NULL when the Event has no canonical Story measurement; never fabricated from source URL count.

metric_inputs.description: The EVIDENCE BEHIND THE SCORES — for each metric, the sub-factor values the coder read off the article and the reason it gave for each, keyed by metric. This is what makes a metric auditable rather than something to trust: the published formula turns these inputs into the served value, so you can recompute it yourself. Shape is `{<metric>: {<sub_factor>: value, why: "…"}}`. Present on most CAMEO+ events; OMITTED where no sub-factor evidence was recorded, which is not the same as none existing — events coded before the field was stored carry nothing, and a backfill has not run. Sub-factor definitions and the formulas: https://docs.gdeltcloud.com/reference/metrics

goldstein_scale.description: Goldstein conflict-cooperation scale, -10 to +10. NULL is DETERMINISTIC, not sparse coverage: it is populated for CAMEO+ POLITICAL events and for every conflict (ACLED) event, and is NULL for the other nine CAMEO+ domains because Goldstein is not defined there. Measured on one production day that is 100% / 100% / 0%, i.e. ~42% of all events — complete wherever the scale means anything.

evidence_source_count.description: Distinct source URLs attached directly to the Event evidence.

supporting_story_count.description: Number of canonical Story references attached to the Event.

uid.description: The incident key. Group or `uniqExact` on this instead of `event_uid` to count INCIDENTS rather than coded stories. Equal to `event_uid` unless a judge confirmed this event duplicates another, in which case it is the surviving event of the group. ALWAYS read `resolution` before trusting it: on an `unadjudicated` row this value is a fallback, not a verdict.

confidence.description: The judge's confidence in the merge, 0–1, and NULL unless `resolution` is `llm`. For a group of three or more this is the WEAKEST link that holds the group together, not the average — a group joined transitively is only as good as its worst edge.

resolution.description: How `uid` was decided. `unadjudicated` — this event was never compared to anything, and `uid` defaults to `event_uid`. `self` — compared and found unique. `llm` — an independent adversarial judge confirmed a duplicate and `uid` names the survivor. Coverage is deliberately partial and visible: only events that were candidates for a duplicate are ever adjudicated.

tool.name: get_activity
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: get activity
tool.description: Publication/change evidence linked to a selected identity or country. Use for ongoing application Event/Story feeds, collectors and Monitors, including late arrivals, substantive changes and removals. Resolve candidates with unified_entity_search first. Baselines and unchanged reloads are excluded. Use time_basis=recorded explicitly; omission preserves publication-date filters. Before coding durable checkpoints read_resource skill://building-with-api/SKILL.md for fixed UTC intervals, source capability, positive window_complete, exact pagination and transactional processing. Publication and recorded time are separate from Event occurrence; unavailable history is not zero.

hour.description: UTC hour selecting a publication bucket. Requires a single date and rejects hours that have not started. The current hour is allowed and describes publications so far; omit for the whole selected day.

kind.description: Published record type to include in activity evidence.

limit.description: Number of records to return on this page; pagination describes how to continue.

change.description: Publication transition. Defaults to all substantive transitions.

cursor.description: Continuation from pagination.next_cursor in the previous response. Keep the other filters unchanged; null means no next page.

entity.description: Selected entity ID from /api/v2/search; returns records linked to that identity. Choices: get_parameter_options('get_activity', 'entity').

country.description: Known country attribution. Evidence distinguishes location, actor origin, reporting and source association. Choices: get_parameter_options('get_activity', 'country').

date_end.description: Last UTC date in the selected time_basis, inclusive. Defaults to date_start and cannot be later than the current UTC day.

date_start.description: First UTC date in the selected time_basis. Defaults to today; future dates are rejected. Neither clock is Event occurrence time.

target_ids.description: Comma-separated stable IDs for the selected roots (up to 25). Use with target_type; roots are unioned. Choices: get_parameter_options('get_activity', 'target_ids').

time_basis.description: Clock for date/hour filters and ordering: published preserves the serving/reference publication time; recorded uses the durable journal commit time and includes late publications when they become available. Omission retains published compatibility. Choose recorded explicitly for ongoing activity Monitors; source dates remain unchanged.

target_type.description: Typed selected root for a shared connected scope: entity or facility. Use with target_ids.

recorded_end.description: Exclusive end of API publication time, as an ISO UTC timestamp. Supply both bounds. Includes late arrivals without changing when the event happened. Cannot combine with reporting-date filters.

related_scope.description: direct matches the selected target. connected includes verified controlled subsidiaries for entities, or identified facility owners and authoritative parent paths for facilities.

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

recorded_start.description: Inclusive start of API publication time, as an ISO UTC timestamp. Supply both bounds. Includes late arrivals without changing when the event happened. Cannot combine with reporting-date filters.

change.description: Retain an explicit removed change as a tombstone with its evidence. It does not require successful current-detail hydration; missing added/updated detail stays retryable.

source.description: Journal catalog key: events for event, stories for story. Match this key and kind to coverage.sources.

source_dataset.description: Returned dataset attribution, distinct from the journal source key. Preserve it verbatim; do not substitute it for source when checking coverage.

country_evidence.description: Returned geographic evidence; preserve its matching basis.

tool.name: get_countries
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: get countries
tool.description: Canonical country directory (directory=true) includes quiet countries, alphabetical search, geography and paging. basis=reporting counts distinct Events by occurrence date and Stories by reporting date; default publication preserves journal behavior. Hourly filtering is available only for publication. Missing coverage remains unavailable. Returns data country records, optional hourly activity and actor-country edges, plus meta coverage/freshness. Directory mode includes quiet countries; unavailable counts remain null.

q.description: Country directory name or ISO code search. Requires directory=true.

hour.description: UTC hour selecting a publication bucket. Requires a single date and rejects hours that have not started. The current hour is allowed and describes publications so far; omit for the whole selected day.

sort.description: Directory order: most recently seen in reporting/publication activity (default), name alphabetically, events or stories descending with stable name ties. Requires directory=true.

basis.description: publication retains the activity journal clock. reporting uses distinct served Events by occurrence date and location country (country_match=location), and Stories by reporting date under every authoritative country association (the Stories summary country_attribution=all mode). Country buckets may overlap for Stories; totals are computed independently. Reporting has day precision and rejects hour.

limit.description: Number of countries per directory page; applies only with directory=true.

offset.description: Number of directory countries to skip; applies only with directory=true.

region.description: Registered geographic region whose member countries narrow the country activity or directory view.

tool.description: Read one resolved Entity's public-source record and reporting context. Returns its public GDELT Cloud URL, attributed thumbnail/avatar when available, linked Story/Event references, co-occurrences, timeline, source_mix and map_pins. Set include_registry=true for authorized registry sections and corporate_context; include_tone=true adds measured media tone (-100..100), coverage and by_language. languages scopes the reporting references and tone. The sources map describes access and measured availability: entitled:false with a missing available field means WITHHELD, never 'not tracked'; entitled sources with status:unknown remain unconfirmed. Preserve these distinctions. Co-occurrence is shared reporting, not a personal relationship or proof of action. Cite publisher evidence for underlying claims.

tool.name: get_monitor_run_matches
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: get monitor run matches
tool.description: Page EVERY match a run counted — get_monitor_run returns only the handful of rows a run retains. A run reports an exact result_count and keeps a small sample, and on most runs those are very different numbers, so reach for this whenever the user asks what a Monitor actually found rather than for a headline count. Each row pairs as_triggered — exactly what the email or webhook asserted, frozen at trigger time and never re-derived — with current, the live record, and a status relating the two: unchanged (still served, asserted fields agree), updated (still served, something the notification asserted has changed), superseded (a Story merged away by same-day reconciliation), or gone (no longer resolvable). ★ A superseded Story generally has NO recoverable successor — say it was merged away rather than searching for a replacement, and never present current as null-because-deleted. tool.name: get_situation
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: get situation
tool.description: Connected Story membership, canonical incidents, entity context and chronology for one Situation. Read meta.situation_source: curated is maintained membership; walked is a weaker graph exploration. Read membership basis/reason and caps; chronology is not proof of cause, and a linked entity is not automatically an actor. Member paging does not shrink whole-situation totals. Returns the REST body unchanged, with shared authentication and query quotas. Use for a maintained narrative and retained membership, not an ad hoc grouping of search hits; inspect edition dates and coverage.

as_of.description: Latest edition published at or before this UTC ISO timestamp. No reconstruction before retention began.

depth.description: Number of adjudicated connection hops from the anchor in a walked Situation. Indirect reachability is not direct comparison with the anchor. Curated membership ignores this value and discloses that in applied_filters.

limit.description: Number of records to return on this page; pagination describes how to continue.

offset.description: Number of records to skip before this page.

include.description: Optional blocks. `edges` returns one undirected row per adjudicated pair across the bounded graph membership, independently of Story pagination (`limit` and `offset`). An edge can reference a Story outside the returned page; fetch the member pages to hydrate those IDs and inspect `caps` and `scopes` for coverage. `/connections` pages membership provenance, not pairwise edges. Edges are omitted by default; `totals.edge_count` reports all pairs in the selected scope even when the returned graph is capped. Choices: get_parameter_options('get_situation', 'include').

date_end.description: Latest member date to include. Defaults to seven days after the anchor Story's own date. The span may not exceed 30 days when both bounds are sent — the same ceiling the service compares against, not a number typed into a sentence. On a curated Situation, sending neither bound returns the whole stored span; sending one leaves the other side open.

story_id.description: A situation_uid (sit_…) from search_situations or any member Story id. Story ids may return a walked exploration when no maintained Situation covers them. Choices: get_parameter_options('get_situation', 'story_id').

max_nodes.description: Member Story cap for the Situation graph, independent of page size. Read truncated and caps.members; the limit can bound membership totals.

date_start.description: Earliest member date to include. Defaults to seven days before the anchor Story's own date — not to today, because a situation is anchored on a Story, not on the request clock. On a curated Situation it filters the stored membership and `coverage` is re-derived from the members that survived, so the window reported is never wider than the payload.

edition_id.description: Retained edition identifier from get_situation_editions. Pins the published snapshot; use it instead of as_of. Choices: get_parameter_options('get_situation', 'edition_id').

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

totals.description: Whole returned Situation grain, independent of member-page limit.

tool.name: intelligence_gpr
tool.title: Read geopolitical risk
tool.description: Atlas geopolitical-risk index at world, continent, region, or country level. `own_coverage` supports the Events and Attention lenses. `world_corpus` is one fixed count-weighted GPR series and requires variant=gpr, metric=gpr, and weighting=attention; it is the reference construction for cross-country time-series work. `geo` is required outside level=world. Official readings below the evidence floor remain null with insufficient_data. Country own_coverage rows may separately return best_effort: an unbanded low-count daily calculation, marked with an asterisk in Atlas. Keep its record count, coder and baseline evidence; it can move sharply on a single record and must not become a confident risk label or trend. Zero coverage, missing or pooled baselines, and open UTC days never get an estimate. Use search_events for the underlying incidents.

tool.name: preview_monitor
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: preview monitor
tool.description: Read-only match query. For an editable draft, setup or review before saving, call gdelt_cloud_monitor_form instead; it provides country/category choices and email/webhook controls. Preview never saves or sends. Run the same canonical Monitor specification on demand without creating it or consuming a Monitor slot. This metered read sends no email or webhooks. Resolve entity names with unified_entity_search first. Use subject_type=query, query_endpoint and query_params to preserve a public request. New committed records are matched after the prior successful checkpoint. history_days is 7 by default or 30 for setup history; it does not change scheduled matching or first enablement. Preview receipts retain their history dates and basis. Scheduled query runs use an independent committed-publication interval. ★ A `category` subject watches an event TYPE with no geography — pass conflict_categories / conflict_subcategories / cameoplus_domains / cameoplus_subcategories (at least one; the server refuses an empty selection by name) and nothing else. That is the shape for "every Battles event worldwide"; every other subject needs an entity, a facility, a point, a geography, or a search phrase.

data.description: Whether legacy subjects match Events, Stories or both. Omission preserves events_and_stories; omit for query subjects, whose endpoint determines the data.

name.description: Short name for the Monitor being previewed.

email.description: Retained email-delivery setting for the draft. Preview never sends email and needs no delivery channel.

region.description: Geographic region for a geography subject, or a geographic refinement of another Monitor subject.

search.description: Semantic Event/Story content to match. Required for topic Monitors. This is not entity-name resolution; use unified_entity_search first.

cadence.description: How often the Monitor checks for newly matching records, subject to the connected account entitlement.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, north-positive, for the place Monitor center; used with longitude.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used to interpret the daily schedule, such as America/New_York. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'timezone').

continent.description: Continent for a geography subject, or a geographic refinement of another Monitor subject.

countries.description: ISO-3 countries for a geography Monitor, or geographic refinements of another subject. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'countries').

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, east-positive, for the place Monitor center; used with latitude.

radius_km.description: Distance in kilometres around a facility or point target. Omission preserves the REST radius of 25 km; omit for query subjects.

daily_hour.description: Hour of the daily check in the selected timezone; retained but ignored for hourly cadence.

entity_ids.description: Resolved entity IDs from unified_entity_search. Select the intended candidates and reuse their e_, wiki: or llm: IDs; never pass bare names. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'entity_ids').

monitor_id.description: Organization Monitor UUID returned by create_monitor or list_monitors; select a Monitor in the connected organization. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'monitor_id').

target_ids.description: Resolved selected entity/facility IDs. Selected-item limit is account-dependent; clarify consequential identity ambiguity. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'target_ids').

description.description: Human-readable purpose or instructions associated with the Monitor draft.

facility_id.description: Canonical facility identifier returned by facilities_search or unified_entity_search; reuse the selected facility ID. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'facility_id').

search_mode.description: Content matching mode; omission preserves the API default.

target_type.description: For connected Monitors: entity or facility. Prefer this subject for company or asset watches.

webhook_url.description: Draft webhook destination. Preview retains it but never contacts it and does not require it.

history_days.description: Setup history: 7 days by default, or 30. Preview never establishes a scheduled checkpoint or sends delivery; incomplete history remains explicit.

query_params.description: Saved filters for query_endpoint. Resolve names first and reuse selected IDs. Omit fixed dates and pagination because scheduled execution supplies its own window and page bounds. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'query_params').

subject_type.description: What the Monitor watches. Connected subjects follow selected entities or facilities; category subjects watch Event types without geography and require a taxonomy scope. Query subjects use the selected endpoint filters.

related_scope.description: Connected scope includes related records; direct selects the roots only. Omission preserves connected for connected subjects.

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

query_endpoint.description: Public read endpoint whose saved filters define a query Monitor; selects the endpoint-specific filter grammar.

params.description: Parameters of the original request, including its discovery dates or pagination. Retained for explanation, independently of the scheduled filters.

endpoint.description: Public read endpoint that produced the original result. Retained as source context; never executed by the schedule.

source_request.description: Original executed endpoint and params, including discovery dates/pagination. Retained for explanation and never executed by the schedule. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'source_request').

source_updates.description: Connected source update groups. Discover exact choices through get_parameter_options. Omit for source defaults; [] disables source updates.

fatalities_only.description: Restrict compatible conflict Events to records with fatalities.

nearby_radius_km.description: Explicit opt-in nearby Events for connected facilities. Omission does not add proximity; never infer an outage from nearby news.

story_categories.description: Story-level topics to watch; distinct from the linked Events taxonomy.

conflict_categories.description: Conflict Event types to watch, such as Battles; scope by what happened rather than Story topic.

conflict_subcategories.description: Conflict sub-event types within the selected conflict_categories; use the corresponding parent categories. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'conflict_subcategories').

cameoplus_subcategories.description: CAMEO+ Event codes within the selected cameoplus_domains; use the corresponding parent domains. Choices: get_parameter_options('preview_monitor', 'cameoplus_subcategories').

evaluation.description: Would-trigger decision, reason, counts, new item ids, and query_coverage (match_scope, pagination_complete, source_history_complete, note). Observed-publication pagination does not prove complete source intake.

window_end.description: Scheduled check interval end; not the query-backed matching date range.

query_window.description: Actual executor query dates selecting matching records. Separate from the scheduled check interval; present for query-backed Previews.

sample_count.description: Number of rows in the Preview sample/window.

window_label.description: Legacy schedule interval label. Use query_window for query-backed matching dates.

window_start.description: Scheduled check interval start; not the query-backed matching date range.

setup_preview.description: Optional 30-day setup evidence: records by kind, active/quiet days, busiest day and cadence estimates. Incomplete history cannot establish exhaustive counts or quiet days.

executed_requests.description: Exact configured-window public GET requests and observed responses, independently paged.

historical_example.description: Separately labelled display-only example from the same filters over an expanded 30-day window when the configured window is empty.

setup_executed_requests.description: Exact public GET requests and observed responses used for the historical setup estimate.

else.description: One accepted on-demand Monitor Preview. It costs 1 Query Unit and does not create a Monitor or send delivery.

tool.name: search_entities
tool.title: Find entities in reporting
tool.description: Discover actors appearing in reporting within date, geography, type or category filters; use for 'who appears in this reporting?' and co-occurrence/coverage questions. The window defaults to the last 30 DAYS; quiet does not mean unknown identity. For initial identity lookup use unified_entity_search with country_match=strict, inspect candidates, select the intended identity, then reuse its exact ID in the relevant endpoint. Coverage metrics describe the requested window; zero means no coverage in this window; null or failed coverage means unknown. Public reporting mentions and shared Stories do not establish interaction, involvement or misconduct. Never choose an ambiguous top hit silently.

days.description: Calendar-date window ending today, in days (max 30). `window=7d` and `days=7` are equivalent. When omitted, entity coverage uses the last 30 calendar days with an observed-time bound over the same span. There is no equivalent numeric default: sending days explicitly selects calendar dates and removes the implicit observed-time bound. Pass `days` explicitly, or `date_start`/`date_end`, whenever the window matters.

sort.description: 'significance' ranks by mention/article weight; 'recent' ranks by latest linked Story/Event evidence.

type.description: Kind of entity appearing in the selected reporting; this is identity classification, not an asserted Event actor role. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'type').

limit.description: Number of Entity cards to return.

cursor.description: Continuation from pagination.next_cursor in the previous response. Keep the other filters unchanged; null means no next page.

domain.description: Deprecated legacy linked CAMEO+ domain filter. Prefer category for new integrations; for DEMOGRAPHIC use category='DEMOGRAPHIC'.

region.description: Geographic region expanded to its member ISO-3 countries; applied through the same country matching rules.

search.description: Free-text search across entity name and Wikipedia URL. Exact-name matches are ranked first via match_score before the standard sort, so `search='Nvidia'` surfaces the Nvidia entity when present in the window. Pass the entity name here — this is the param, not `name`.

country.description: Country filter. Accepts ISO-3, ISO-2, FIPS or an English name; comma-separate for OR. Matches the event's own location OR either actor's origin country by default, so a result can include events that happened elsewhere — set `country_match` to narrow it to location only. The definition in force is echoed as `applied_filters.country_match`. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'country').

category.description: Linked Event top-level category: a Conflict event_type such as 'Battles' or one CAMEO+ domain such as 'INFRASTRUCTURE'. Filters Entities by linked Story/Event evidence. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'category').

end_date.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD. With days only, start_date is computed as the trailing window ending here. Defaults to today UTC.

continent.description: Continent expanded to its member ISO-3 countries; applied through the same country matching rules.

languages.description: ISO source-language filter. Restricts coverage metrics to articles in those languages. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'languages').

categories.description: Optional multi-select version of category. Values are OR'd together and sent to the API as category=Battles,CRIME. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'categories').

start_date.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD. With end_date, defines an explicit MCP Entity discovery window of at most 30 days.

subcategory.description: Linked Event subcategory string validated at runtime. Requires category/categories and filters Entities by linked Story/Event evidence. For CAMEO+ categories, prefer stable event codes such as TE01 or IN03; codebook labels are accepted as legacy aliases. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'subcategory').

event_family.description: Deprecated legacy linked-evidence filter. Prefer category/categories, which imply Conflict vs CAMEO+. Still accepted for backwards compatibility.

recorded_end.description: Exclusive end of API publication time, as an ISO UTC timestamp. Supply both bounds. Includes late arrivals without changing when the event happened. Cannot combine with reporting-date filters.

country_match.description: Which definition of "in this country" the `country` / `region` / `continent` filters use. Applies to `region` and `continent` too, since both expand into the same country set. Note that `group_by=country` buckets on the event's own location, while the default match also admits actor origin — so a filtered total and the bucket for that same country can differ. Pass `country_match=location` when you need the two to agree.

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

has_fatalities.description: Set true to return Entities linked to fatal Events or Stories with fatal linked Events.

include_images.description: Retain source article image URLs on returned cards when available.

recorded_start.description: Inclusive start of API publication time, as an ISO UTC timestamp. Supply both bounds. Includes late arrivals without changing when the event happened. Cannot combine with reporting-date filters.

co_occurring_with.description: Return the entities that appear ALONGSIDE this one — the entities linked to the same Stories, over the same window, narrowed by every other filter on this endpoint. Accepts a spine id (`e_…`), a news id (`wiki:…`) or a name, resolved through the same arbiter as `entity=` on `/api/v2/events` and `/api/v2/stories`, so one handle means the same entity everywhere. The subject is never returned in its own results. Co-occurrence is measured over SHARED STORIES — appearing in the same coverage, which is not a claim that the two entities interacted. A handle that resolves to nothing returns an EMPTY list with a `linkage` reason in `applied_filters`, never the global top entities. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_entities', 'co_occurring_with').

civilian_targeting.description: Set true to return Entities linked to Conflict Event/Story evidence where ACLED civilian_targeting is populated.

x-gdelt-taxonomy.subcategory_rule: Subcategory is validated against its parent category/categories. Use stable returned codes; legacy labels are accepted aliases. Unknown choices fail before billing. For unfamiliar labels, search get_event_taxonomy with a known category and the default page size.
x-gdelt-taxonomy.subcategory_discovery: Optional get_event_taxonomy(category=...) or get_parameter_options with parent_value scopes the choices; familiar valid filters need no lookup.

inputSchema.x-gdelt-errorRecovery: If category or subcategory validation fails, choose from compact accepted_values when present, otherwise use nearest_values or run a subcategory summary.

cursor.description: Current page position; null on the first page. Use next_cursor for continuation.

next_cursor.description: Copy this continuation token as cursor with the same filters. Null ends this page walk; pagination exhaustion does not establish source coverage.

name.description: Canonical display name — the most-mentioned raw_name variant pointing at this Wikipedia URL.

event_count.description: Coded events linked to those Stories over the same window — the events /api/v2/events?entity= returns. NULL when the aggregate is unavailable; zero only after a successful empty read.

story_count.description: Distinct Stories in this window that mention this entity — counted once each, never once per day they ran. The same population /api/v2/stories?entity= pages through, and the same number /api/v2/entities/{id} serves as metrics.story_count. NULL when the aggregate is unavailable; zero only after a successful empty read.

article_count.description: Articles that mention this entity, across those Stories. This is the entity's footprint, NOT the article volume of the Stories themselves — that is larger, and /api/v2/stories carries it per Story as metrics.article_count. NULL when the aggregate is unavailable; zero only after a successful empty read.

mention_count.description: How many times this entity is mentioned across the articles of those Stories. Higher than Articles when an article names the entity more than once. NULL when the aggregate is unavailable; zero only after a successful empty read.

metrics.description: Resolved coverage counts for the requested window and filters. NULL means unavailable, never zero activity.

sources.description: Per-source entitlement control-plane on Entity detail: for each data source (news, events, tone, gem, sec, sanctions, china, epoch_ai, facilities, gov, share_of_voice) whether the caller's plan is entitled, plus availability for entitled sources. Non-entitled sources report a uniform locked state and omit availability (no availability leak). The corresponding section objects (news, events, tone, sec, ...) appear at the top level only for entitled sources.

map_pins.description: Geo-located Events linked to the entity (Entity detail), for map rendering. Each item: event_uid, event_family, event_date, title, country, category, latitude, longitude.

timeline.description: Per-day activity for the entity over the window (Entity detail). Each item: date, article_count, mention_count.

image_url.description: Best-effort Wikipedia thumbnail URL for UI rendering.

wikipedia.description: Compact Wikipedia enrichment when available, including thumbnail_url, description, page_url, and summary on detail responses.

avatar_url.description: Best-effort compact avatar URL, usually the same as image_url.

total.description: Exact directly owned registry-unit row count; excludes participant-role matches.

by_type.description: Counts within the returned maximum-60 owned facility preview, not whole-portfolio type totals.

url.description: Public GDELT Cloud facility record. Use for human-facing citations; null when no valid facility identity is available.

entity_id.description: Terminal spine `e_…` id. Null when the source names an owner that has not resolved to the spine.

owners.description: Atomic owner records; ids and names are never separate positional arrays.

status.description: `mixed` when represented units disagree; otherwise a normalized lower-case lifecycle status. Null means unknown.

unit_id.description: Source registry-unit `f_…` id on unit rows; null on canonical site rows.

capacity.description: Native registry-unit capacity. Unknown on a multi-unit site; no conversion or cross-unit aggregation is inferred.

unit_ids.description: Source registry-unit ids represented by this site or unit row.

detail_url.description: REST API detail path; use url for a public facility page.

unit_count.description: Distinct source registry units represented by this row.

commodities.description: Normalized commodity memberships; a mine and processing plant retain separate identities.

facility_id.description: Identifier for this row: canonical `s_…` site id in the default site view, or source registry-unit `f_…` id with `granularity=unit`.

anyOf.description: Retained source evidence for the selected point coordinates.

geo_precision.description: Source coordinate precision; nearby reporting is only a geographic screen.

news_activity.description: Only present with sort=news_activity. Distinct canonical Events in the exact served dates disclosed by meta.news_activity. Owner and nearby counts overlap; use observed_event_count for their union. Missing matching scopes remain null.

status_source.description: Single raw source status when all represented units agree; null otherwise.

status.description: Normalized lower-case lifecycle status; null when unknown.

status_source.description: Status exactly as published by the source registry.

unit_statuses.description: Per-unit source and normalized status evidence.

status_sources.description: Distinct raw status spellings published by the source registry.

unit_capacities.description: Per-registry-unit native capacities. Values remain null until retained by the source projection; units such as mtpa are not MW.

status.description: Normalized lower-case lifecycle status; null means unknown.

status_breakdown.description: Registry-unit counts by normalized lifecycle status.

canonical_site_id.description: Canonical `s_…` physical-site id shared by every registry unit at the site.

source_memberships.description: All source memberships of the canonical physical site.

entity_id.description: Terminal entity selected by participant_entity.

matched_participation.description: Present only with participant_entity. Matching source assertions for this entity, restricted to the selected role when participant_role is provided. A compute-user, operator or tenant role is not ownership. At most 25 assertions per physical site; inspect truncated.

participation.description: Bounded reverse facility-participant preview on entity detail, gated by can_use_facilities. Owned-facility totals stay separate. Registry roles and evidence are current source observations, independent of the news date window. Continue via api_url and pagination.next_cursor; this is not a complete portfolio count.

facilities.description: Facility section when available under can_use_facilities. `total` is the exact count of directly owned registry-unit rows; `facilities` is a maximum-60 preview, and `by_type` counts only those returned preview cards. `participation` is a separate bounded reverse preview of source-reported roles at canonical sites; it is not ownership, is not inherited through corporate parents, and is not a complete participant count.

source_mix.description:
Top news domains covering the entity over the window (Entity detail). Each item: domain, article_count, story_count.

**Deprecated 2026-08-29; scheduled for removal on or after 2026-09-28.** Complete per-article source coverage cannot be served reliably within this endpoint. Do not interpret this deprecated field as a complete source inventory. There is no complete entity-wide source aggregation replacement. For per-outlet coverage of a Story, read `source_count` and the domain list on `GET /api/v2/stories/{id}`.

scored_rows.description: Scored entity-Story-day rows covered in this language.

article_count.description: Total evidence items in this language across the scored Stories — the denominator behind avg_tone_score.

avg_tone_score.description: Blended tone for Stories covered in this language, weighted by that language’s evidence-item count.

avg_news_tone_score.description: News-only tone in this language. null = not measured.

avg_social_tone_score.description: Social-only tone in this language. null = not measured.

by_language.description: Per-language tone over ALL scored Stories in the window (never the bounded evidence sample) — the same rows the tone endpoints return as `language_breakdown`, which is where the field comes from. Use it to compare how an entity is covered across languages, e.g. markedly more negative in one language than another. Aggregated over the entity this detail response is about. A component (`avg_news_tone_score` / `avg_social_tone_score`) is `null` when no evidence of that kind was scored in that language — never 0, which is the middle of the neutral band and would report a reading nobody took; its paired article count is 0 in exactly those rows.

entity_tone.description: Present on Entity detail when include_tone=true and the caller is allowed to access preview tone metadata. tone_status may be scored, reviewable, partial, or not_available.

latest_date.description: Most recent date the Entity appeared in a Story or Event within the requested window.

recorded_at.description: Committed availability timestamp, present for recorded-interval queries.

published_at.description: Original publication timestamp, present for recorded-interval queries.

cooccurrences.description: Co-occurring entities — people/organizations that appear in the same Stories as this entity within the window, ranked by shared-Story count. Returned on Entity detail. Each item: name, type (person|organization), wikipedia_url, story_count (shared Stories), source ('news'), url (entity page).

coverage_status.description: Entity-list windowed metrics: available = measured activity; no_coverage = successful reads measured zero; partial = some aggregates unavailable; unavailable = no aggregate established. An unavailable count is null. Name search may retain quiet reference matches.

total.description: Distinct recorded offices, independent of the bounded preview.

status.description: Publisher status across recorded terms. Former requires all terms to be explicitly ended; missing dates never infer status.

checked.description: False when office evidence or canonical identity could not be checked.

is_public_official.description: Published office evidence exists. Null means unavailable, not a negative finding.

relationships.description: Each direction is bounded to 25 assertions. Failed measurement returns null, not an empty relationship list. Subsidiary, consolidation and equity-interest claims remain distinct.

parent_summaries.description: At most five distinct parents. Counts aggregate each complete served alias family. Unknown/withheld counts are null; successfully measured absence is zero. Records belong to the parent.

corporate_context.description: Entity detail with include_registry=true: one-hop recorded corporate parents and children, gated on can_use_exposure. Parent SEC identifiers and global-list counts are separately attributed and gated by their source flags. Current recorded knowledge, not a historical ownership snapshot; missing links do not establish independence.

latest_observed_news_date.description: Entity-list recent ordering key: latest dated Story/Event mention in the candidate news index, at day precision. Separate from resolved coverage latest_date/counts; never a registry-update or link-processing timestamp. Null for reference-only name matches.

items.description: One canonical Entity with resolved news coverage in the requested window. Explicit name search can retain reference entities without measured news coverage. Entity Tone may be included on detail; unavailable tone is not neutral.

tool.name: search_events
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: search events
tool.description: Retrieve a bounded evidence sample. For counts, trends or "what changed", call summarize_events first for each period with identical structured filters, then sample relevant Events. Displayed pages cannot establish totals or mean metrics. Territorial scope uses country_match=location. Continuous events coverage begins 2026-03-01. Use consecutive windows of at most 30 inclusive days; a calendar month can be too long. Finish pagination.next_cursor within each fixed window before starting the next chunk without a cursor. Without an explicit window, entity filters default to 30 days and other queries to the last 24 hours. meta.query_window reports the effective predicates; meta.coverage describes the available corpus. Retrieve GDELT Cloud's self-produced coded reported Events as supporting evidence: incidents, conflict, diplomacy and economic/energy developments. Classification and temporal order do not prove causation or operational impact. Supports Conflict and CAMEO+ Events, plain-English geography whose region/continent filters expand to country lists, optional admin1 drilldown, categories/subcategories, true embedding semantic search, fatality/civilian-targeting filtering, canonical metric min/max filters, and significance or recent sorting. Returns clean Event cards with geo, actors, Goldstein/severity and CAMEO+ metrics, linked Stories/Entities, GDELT Cloud Story URLs for citation, top 3 articles, source favicons, article sharing images, and linked Entity thumbnails. Entity matching uses coverage through linked Stories; a mention does not establish that the entity is a party to the Event. For ongoing collectors and company watches, discover get_activity (recorded time) and read_resource skill://building-with-api/SKILL.md before coding checkpoints; occurrence-date searches are not an arrival feed. Use for classified evidence and the four CAMEO+ metrics after a population summary; a result page cannot establish population averages.

bbox.description: Geographic bounding box 'lat_min,lon_min,lat_max,lon_max'. Monitor replay requests may supply this exact filter.

days.description: Window days. Omit for the REST default: 30 days with entity, rolling past 24 hours otherwise. Set only to deliberately change that window.

near.description: Point filter 'latitude,longitude'. Pair with radius_km. Monitor place/facility replay requests supply these exact values.

sort.description: 'significance' ranks by canonical product importance; 'recent' ranks newest first.

limit.description: Number of Event cards to return on this page; follow pagination.next_cursor for further results.

admin1.description: Optional state/province/admin1 name discovered with list_admin1. Filters Event location only, not actor origin. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'admin1').

cursor.description: Continuation from pagination.next_cursor in the previous response. Keep the other filters unchanged; null means no next page.

domain.description: Deprecated legacy CAMEO+ domain filter. Prefer category/categories for new integrations.

entity.description: Resolved terminal entity id, news id, or name. Uses the same shared resolver as Stories and entity products. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'entity').

office.description: Office ID from offices_search. Matches published holders during the reporting window or office_as_of; unioned with entity. Refuses >1,000 holders; applied_filters.office_holders discloses unresolved identities. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'office').

region.description: Plain-English region, expanded to its ISO-3 country list. OR across Event location and actor-origin countries.

search.description: Search text. With search_mode=lexical this is a literal phrase in served Events title/summary or Stories title. By default the complete phrase is checked against name/title evidence and is also embedded for vector ranking; literal matches rank first and remaining results are conceptual neighbours. There is no boolean parser: a query shaped `a OR b` is reduced to its first term and the response says so. Costs an embedding call and can return 503 SEMANTIC_SEARCH_UNAVAILABLE.

country.description: One or more plain-English country names or ISO-3 codes (legacy FIPS accepted). OR across Event location and actor origins; pass a list. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'country').

category.description: One category string, e.g. Battles or INFRASTRUCTURE. Use categories for multiple choices. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'category').

end_date.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end, default today UTC. With days only, computes the trailing start.

continent.description: Plain-English continent, expanded to ISO-3 countries; same matching semantics as country.

languages.description: Source-language ISO codes, e.g. [ar, zh, en]. Omit for all languages. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'languages').

radius_km.description: Distance in kilometres from the selected point for geographic proximity matching.

categories.description: JSON array (OR combined), e.g. ["INFRASTRUCTURE", "ECONOMIC"], not a JSON-encoded string. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'categories').

start_date.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start; at most 30 days with end_date. With days only, computes end_date.

target_ids.description: Comma-separated stable IDs for the selected roots (up to 25). Use with target_type; roots are unioned. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'target_ids').

search_mode.description: Search interpretation. semantic is a bounded hybrid search: complete-phrase name/title matches rank ahead of vector-ranked conceptual neighbours. lexical filters the complete serving set for a case-insensitive literal phrase in Events title/summary or Stories title before pagination; no stemming or boolean parsing. Lexical mode requires a supported serving snapshot and never falls back to the warehouse.

subcategory.description: Runtime-validated within category/categories. Conflict labels or CAMEO+ stable codes; codebook labels accepted as aliases. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'subcategory').

target_type.description: Typed selected root for a shared connected scope: entity or facility. Use with target_ids.

entity_match.description: Coverage through a linked Story, not proof of participation in the Event. Omit to inherit REST defaults.

event_family.description: Deprecated legacy filter. Prefer category/categories, which imply Conflict vs CAMEO+. Still accepted for backwards compatibility.

office_as_of.description: Valid-time YYYY-MM-DD for office holders. Separate from reporting/replay dates. Missing term evidence is excluded.

recorded_end.description: Exclusive end of API publication time, as an ISO UTC timestamp. Supply both bounds. Includes late arrivals without changing when the event happened. Cannot combine with reporting-date filters. Event and Story lists return records first made available in this interval, not later updates to existing records. Use /api/v2/activity for changes.

actor_country.description: Either actor-origin country, ignoring direction; excludes matches based only on Event location. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'actor_country').

country_match.description: Which definition of "in this country" the `country` / `region` / `continent` filters use. Applies to `region` and `continent` too, since both expand into the same country set. Note that `group_by=country` buckets on the event's own location, while the default match also admits actor origin — so a filtered total and the bucket for that same country can differ. Pass `country_match=location` when you need the two to agree.

entity_family.description: Which canonical ids the handle stands for. `expand` (default) also matches the sibling ids the entity arbiter has already merged into the same real-world entity — a Wikipedia identity minted twice under different URL spellings, for instance — and echoes the union back as `applied_filters.entity_ids_expanded`. `exact` restricts to the one canonical id the handle resolves to, reproducing the pre-2026-08-25 counts.

include_total.description: Add `pagination.estimated_total` — how many events match the filters, ignoring the page. Off by default because it costs a second scan of the same window. Counted from the SAME filters and the same row source as the page, so it always describes the result set you are walking. It is `null` (not a number) on a `search=` request: semantic retrieval is bounded by a candidate cap, so any total there would describe the candidate pool rather than the matching events. Without it, `pagination.next_cursor` still tells you whether more rows exist — non-null means yes, null means the walk is finished.

magnitude_max.description: Upper bound on CAMEO+ scale of the change or action. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

magnitude_min.description: Lower bound on CAMEO+ scale of the change or action. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

related_scope.description: direct matches the selected target. connected includes verified controlled subsidiaries for entities, or identified facility owners and authoritative parent paths for facilities.

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

confidence_max.description: Upper bound on coding confidence rather than a probability of the real-world outcome.

confidence_min.description: Lower bound on Event coding confidence. This is the public replacement for the legacy min_confidence API parameter; it does not estimate the probability of a real-world outcome.

has_fatalities.description: Set true for fatality monitoring. This is the only public fatality filter; there are no fatality min/max params.

include_images.description: Retain source article image URLs on returned cards when available.

recorded_start.description: Inclusive start of API publication time, as an ISO UTC timestamp. Supply both bounds. Includes late arrivals without changing when the event happened. Cannot combine with reporting-date filters. Event and Story lists return records first made available in this interval, not later updates to existing records. Use /api/v2/activity for changes.

nearby_radius_km.description: Opt-in proximity for a facility target scope. Matches Events near any selected facility; this is separate from owner coverage and requires target_type=facility with related_scope=direct.

significance_max.description: Upper bound on canonical Event importance across coding families.

significance_min.description: Lower bound on canonical Event importance across coding families.

civilian_targeting.description: Set true for Conflict Events where ACLED civilian_targeting is populated; set false to exclude civilian-targeting Conflict Events.

goldstein_scale_max.description: Upper bound on signed conflict/cooperation score; negative values describe conflictual actions, positive values cooperation; meaningful for Conflict and CAMEO+ POLITICAL.

goldstein_scale_min.description: Lower bound on signed conflict/cooperation score; negative values describe conflictual actions, positive values cooperation; meaningful for Conflict and CAMEO+ POLITICAL.

source_actor_country.description: Acting-side origin countries (names or ISO-3). Pair with target_actor_country for direction. Conflict primary actor need not be the initiator. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'source_actor_country').

target_actor_country.description: Receiving-side origin countries (names or ISO-3). Pair with source_actor_country to preserve direction. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_events', 'target_actor_country').

include_entity_images.description: Retain linked entity thumbnails when include_images is enabled; otherwise this switch has no effect.

market_sensitivity_max.description: Upper bound on CAMEO+ market-relevant information rather than a price-move prediction. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

market_sensitivity_min.description: Lower bound on CAMEO+ market-relevant information rather than a price-move prediction. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

systemic_importance_max.description: Upper bound on CAMEO+ importance of the affected system. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

systemic_importance_min.description: Lower bound on CAMEO+ importance of the affected system. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

propagation_potential_max.description: Upper bound on CAMEO+ conditions allowing an effect to spread. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

propagation_potential_min.description: Lower bound on CAMEO+ conditions allowing an effect to spread. This selects Events with that CAMEO+ measurement.

x-gdelt-taxonomy.subcategory_rule: Subcategory is validated against its parent category/categories. Use stable returned codes; legacy labels are accepted aliases. Unknown choices fail before billing. For unfamiliar labels, search get_event_taxonomy with a known category and the default page size.
x-gdelt-taxonomy.subcategory_discovery: Optional get_event_taxonomy(category=...) or get_parameter_options with parent_value scopes the choices; familiar valid filters need no lookup.

inputSchema.x-gdelt-errorRecovery: If category or subcategory validation fails, choose from compact accepted_values when present, otherwise use nearest_values or run a subcategory summary.

geo.description: Resolved location: country, admin1, place name, lat/lon.

metrics.description: Core CAMEO+ metrics: magnitude (0–10, compare within category), systemic_importance / propagation_potential / market_sensitivity (0–1 scores, not probabilities). Null is unknown. Auxiliary significance/Goldstein may be returned; do not replace core metrics or display coding confidence.

applied_filters.description: Echo of the resolved filters; `ignored` lists dropped/unknown args.

else.description: List of Event records.

data.description: Compact records retain IDs, returned links, selected images, evidence and metrics where available; unknown values remain unknown.

tool.name: search_situations
tool.title: GDELT Cloud: search situations
tool.description: Find maintained Situations by title, canonical entity or Story/Event membership. Country takes ISO-3 codes such as UKR, never country names such as Ukraine. Latest development sorting uses reporting dates and genuine first-observed evidence, never refresh time. totals describes lifetime membership; selected_scope and category_summaries describe requested reporting dates. Follow situation_uid with get_situation. Search is title term matching; entity takes a resolved ID. Country and category match the same member-linked coded Event, not primary Situation geography or actor nationality; both date bounds are required for these facets (maximum 30 days). Shared REST authentication and query quotas apply.

sort.description: Ranking. `recent` uses latest reporting date, then first-observed membership time; `created` orders by immutable creation time, newest first; `updated` orders by the latest serving-membership refresh; article_count, story_count and event_count are volume alternatives; `span_days` puts the longest-running occurrence first — the inclusive day count between `span.start` and `span.end`, with an unmeasured span last. Recent never uses refresh time or volume. Every order breaks ties on `situation_uid`, so paging with `offset` is stable.

limit.description: Number of Situations returned on this page. `pagination.total` is the true number matching your filters, counted separately from the page, so `has_more` is measured rather than inferred from a full page.

entity.description: Canonical entity handle or name, using the same identity resolution as Stories. Requires both reporting date bounds, at most 30 days. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_situations', 'entity').

offset.description: Number of records to skip before this page.

search.description: Free text matched against the stored `title` OR the headline of any member Story reported inside the window (the last 30 days when no dates are sent) — a case-insensitive match requiring EVERY whitespace-separated term to appear in one of the two, so `nepal flood` matches "Flash floods hit northern Nepal-Tibet border" and `AI slowdown` finds a Situation titled "Trump says US will not slow AI race" through a member headline that says slowdown. The phrase also runs through the hybrid `GET /api/v2/stories?search=` in the same window, and a Situation holding one of the top-ranked Stories matches too, so `AI pause` can reach the same Situation through meaning; `meta.search.semantic_story_candidates` reports how many Story hits that arm contributed and `meta.search.note` says when it was unavailable. What it CANNOT do: read article text or entities directly; and `title` is the PEAK member's headline, re-stamped every time the Situation is recomputed. At most 8 terms; more is refused with `INVALID_SEARCH` rather than silently truncated. To search what a Situation is actually ABOUT, run `GET /api/v2/stories?search=` and take any returned Story id to `/api/v2/situations/{story_id}`.

country.description: Any member-linked coded Event located in this ISO-3 country. Actor nationality is not used. Requires date_start and date_end, at most 30 inclusive days. Both country and category match the SAME Event. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_situations', 'country').

category.description: Any member-linked coded Event in this Event taxonomy category, not Story category or a primary Situation label. Requires both reporting date bounds, at most 30 days. Country and category match the same Event. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_situations', 'category').

date_end.description: Return Situations that had already begun by this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — matched against `span_start`. Sent together with `date_start` the pair selects every occurrence whose span OVERLAPS the window; sent alone it leaves the other side open. An inverted pair is refused with `INVALID_DATE_RANGE` rather than answered empty.

story_id.description: Stored Situation UID from search_situations, or a member Story ID when supported by this operation; reuse the returned identifier. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_situations', 'story_id').

event_uid.description: Coded Event UID from search_events; selects Situations with member Stories linked to that Event. Choices: get_parameter_options('search_situations', 'event_uid').

date_start.description: Return Situations still running on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) — matched against `span_end`, so an occurrence that began earlier and is ongoing IS returned. Optional and independent of `date_end`. There is no maximum span: the Situations table is one row per adjudicated occurrence and is small by construction, so this is a filter on a stored column rather than a bound on how much is scanned.

min_events.description: Minimum coded Events at canonical-incident grain across the whole current servable membership. The public discovery page sends min_stories=2&min_events=2; the API applies no minimum when omitted. Use min_stories=1&min_events=0 to include emerging seeds, including reporting with no coded Events. Explicit zero is permitted.

include_map.description: Include country aggregates over every matching Situation, independently of page size. Requires a reporting window of at most 30 days.

min_stories.description: Minimum member Stories across the whole current servable membership, not the selected reporting window. The public discovery page sends min_stories=2&min_events=2; the API applies no minimum when omitted. Use min_stories=1&min_events=0 to include emerging seeds. This filter does not change creation, growth or direct UID lookup.

min_articles.description: Minimum articles across the member Stories — the best single proxy for how big an occurrence got, and the default sort key. Compared against the stored `article_count`.

response_mode.description: Compact chat projection or unchanged bounded full API response; neither fetches another page.

items.description: Stored Situation summary: situation_uid, title, span, counts and counts_updated_at. Counts cover the whole stored span, not only the search window.

data.description: Situation records.

pagination.description: Offset paging; use offset and limit, not a cursor.

applied_filters.description: Echo of the resolved filters; `ignored` lists dropped/unknown args.

else.description: List of Situation records.

data.description: Compact records retain IDs, returned links, selected images, evidence and metrics where available; unknown values remain unknown.

_mcp_projection.description: Explicitly discloses omitted fields or shortened evidence.

outputSchema.description: Full preserves the bounded API response. Compact preserves evidence, coverage, filters and pagination with explicit projection disclosure; neither fetches other pages.
